title: Capability probe
description: A harmless service that exists so the applicator has something real and safe to start, limit, health-check and stop. It writes a readiness file, holds a declared resident working set, and exits cleanly on SIGTERM. Validating against an essential host service would risk the machine; validating against sleep would give nothing to observe a memory limit against.

implementations.title: Capability probe
implementations.description: Holds 8 MiB resident and answers a readiness check.
